claims.statement: An associated DTO class appears in the Dto & Projections section of the JPA Structure tab and in the Editor Toolbar.
claims.supports: DTO class will appear in Dto & Projections section in JPA Structure tab and Editor Toolbar
claims.ourFeature: structure_related.rs group DTOs and Projections; editor_links.rs command editor-related
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Structure view group DTOs and Projections plus the related-artifacts command (status bar item click) standing in for the editor toolbar. Not checked: a toolbar at the top of the editor, the JPA Structure tab layout.

claims.statement: A gutter icon in the DTO class navigates to its associated entity.
claims.supports: gutter icon will appear in the DTO class to navigate to its associated entity
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Gutter line marker (navigate icon) in the DTO to its entity. Not checked: gutter drawing, the click, the original's icon.

undocumented: whether the entity side shows a link back to DTOs
